title: Opening and introductions at 35 West 12th Street
summary: Schoenberg opens the February 17, 2007 Smithsonian interview with Hentoff in New York.

story.theme_name: Starting the tape: names, dates and places
story.community_name: Opening the interview: introductions, date and place

blocks.x: Funding for the Smithsonian Jazz Oral History Program NEA Jazz Master interview was provided by the National Endowment for the Arts.
Interviewer: Loren Schoenberg with audio engineer Ken Kimery Description: Transcript, 80 pp.

It’s February 17th, 2007. We’re at 35 West 12th Street in New York City. My name is Loren Schoenberg. Our guest is Nat Hentoff. We’re interviewing him for the Smithsonian Oral History project. I start off by saying, Nat, this is something I’ve been looking forward to do for a long time. It’s an honor to be talking to you this afternoon.
Thank you sir. It’s an honor to talk to somebody who’s an actual musician, not a jazz master without a horn.
